---
title: "Indirect effect of influenza vaccination coverage on the circulation of respiratory viruses"
subtitle: "Figure 1A: Respiratory virus circulation (2016–2024)"
output: html_document
---
## Load packages and set plotting theme
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr);library(tidyverse);library(tidyr);library(lubridate);library(ggpubr)
library(anytime);library(reshape2);library(ggplot2);library(RColorBrewer);library(readxl)
library(gridExtra);library(grid);library(purrr);library(entropy)
source("../plot_theme.R")
options(scipen = 999)

out_path1 <- "output"
dir.create(out_path1, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Prepare and save Figure 1 summary data
```{r eval=FALSE}
# Load and prepare data.
if (FALSE) {
dat <- read.csv("../00_data/multi_vaccine_cases_climate.csv")
dat$HEMISPHERE <- ifelse(dat$cen_lat > 0, "NH", "SH")

dat  <-  dat %>%
  filter((year >= 2016 & year <= 2024)) 

dir.create(out_path1)
dat_rsv = subset(dat ,dat$virus=="RSV")
dat_inf <- dat_rsv
dat_inf$cases <- dat_inf$INF_ALL
dat_inf$AAP <- dat_inf$flu_AAP
dat_inf$virus <- "IV"

dat_infA <- dat_rsv
dat_infA$cases <- dat_infA$INF_A
dat_infA$AAP <- dat_infA$fluA_AAP
dat_infA$virus <- "IAV"

dat_infB <- dat_rsv
dat_infB$AAP <- dat_infB$fluB_AAP
dat_infB$cases <- dat_infB$INF_B
dat_infB$virus <- "IBV"
dat1 <- subset(dat ,!dat$virus=="RSV")
dat2 <- rbind(dat1,dat_inf,dat_infA,dat_infB,dat_rsv)

# Calculate summary statistics of AAP and cases by virus, hemisphere, and time
res_aap_group <- dat2 %>%
  group_by(virus,HEMISPHERE,year_decimal) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_AAP = mean(AAP, na.rm = TRUE),                     # Mean 
    Q2.5_AAP = quantile(AAP, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),          # 2.5th percentile
    median_AAP = median(AAP, na.rm = TRUE),                 # Median
    Q97.5_AAP = quantile(AAP, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),         # 97.5th percentile
    
    mean_cases = mean(cases, na.rm = TRUE),                 # Mean 
    Q2.5_cases = quantile(cases, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),      # 2.5th percentile
    median_cases = median(cases, na.rm = TRUE),             # Median
    Q97.5_cases = quantile(cases, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)      # 97.5th percentile
  )

# Save summary statistics for Figure 1
saveRDS(
  res_aap_group,
  "Fig1A_summary.rds",
  compress = "xz"
)
}
```
## Load precomputed Figure 1A summary data
```{r}
# Load results
res_aap_group <- readRDS("Fig1A_summary.rds")
```

## Plot Figure 1A
```{r fig.width=18.2, fig.height=8, dpi=300}
virus_select <- c("IAV","IBV","RSV","PIV","RV","ADV","HMPV")
res_aap_subset <- subset(res_aap_group, virus %in% virus_select)

cols <- c("#00A087B2","#3C5488FF","#FED439B2","#c25b88","#4DBBD5FF","#B09C85B2","#E64B35BF")

res_aap_NH <- subset(res_aap_subset, res_aap_subset$HEMISPHERE == "NH")
res_aap_NH_IAV <- subset(res_aap_group, res_aap_group$HEMISPHERE == "NH"&res_aap_group$virus == "IAV")
res_aap_NH$virus <- factor(res_aap_NH$virus,levels = virus_select,ordered=TRUE)

K_NH     <- max(res_aap_NH$median_cases, na.rm = TRUE)
coef_NH  <- 800 / (100 * K_NH)

# Plot Figure 1A
p1_nh <- 
  ggplot(res_aap_NH, aes(x =  year_decimal, y = median_cases, color=virus,fill = virus)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack",alpha=0.7) +
  geom_point(data = res_aap_NH_IAV,  aes(x = year_decimal, 
                y = median_AAP * (K_NH * coef_NH)),stroke = 2,  
            size = 3, alpha = 0.7,inherit.aes = FALSE,shape=21,fill="#00A087B2",color="black")+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=2020.16),lty='dashed',colour ="black",linewidth=1)+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=2023.333),lty='dashed',colour ="black",linewidth=1)+
  scale_y_continuous(limits  = c(0, 800),expand  = c(0, 0),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~./(K_NH * coef_NH),name   = "RP of IAV detections (%)",breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2016, 2025,1),expand = c(0, 0.25))+
  labs(title = "Northern Hemisphere",x = "",y = "Positive detections") +
  mytheme +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"))+
  theme(panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(),panel.grid.minor.x=element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(),panel.grid.minor.y=element_blank())+ 
  scale_color_manual(name = '',values = cols  )+
  scale_fill_manual(name = '',values = cols  )+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=1,byrow = T),color=guide_legend(nrow=1,byrow = T))
p1_nh


res_aap_SH <- subset(res_aap_subset, res_aap_subset$HEMISPHERE == "SH")
res_aap_SH_IAV <- subset(res_aap_group, res_aap_group$HEMISPHERE == "SH"&res_aap_group$virus == "IAV")
res_aap_SH$virus <- factor(res_aap_SH$virus,levels = virus_select,ordered=TRUE)
K_SH     <- max(res_aap_SH$median_cases, na.rm = TRUE)
coef_SH  <- 2050 / (100 * K_SH)

p1_sh <- 
  ggplot(res_aap_SH, aes(x =  year_decimal, y = median_cases, color=virus,fill = virus)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack",alpha=0.7) +
  geom_point(data = res_aap_SH_IAV, aes(x = year_decimal, 
                y = median_AAP * (K_SH * coef_SH)),stroke = 2, 
            size = 3, alpha = 0.7,inherit.aes = FALSE,shape=21,fill="#00A087B2",color="black")+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=2020.16),lty='dashed',colour ="black",linewidth=1)+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=2023.333),lty='dashed',colour ="black",linewidth=1)+
  scale_y_continuous( limits = c(0, 2050),expand = c(0, 0),
                      sec.axis = sec_axis(~./(K_SH * coef_SH),name='RP of IAV detections (%)',breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2016, 2025,1),expand = c(0, 0.25))+
  labs(title = "Southern Hemisphere",x = "",y = "Positive detections") +
  mytheme +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"))+
  theme(panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(),panel.grid.minor.x=element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(),panel.grid.minor.y=element_blank())+ 
  scale_color_manual(name = '',values = cols  )+
  scale_fill_manual(name = '',values = cols  )+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=1,byrow = T),color=guide_legend(nrow=1,byrow = T))
p1_sh

fig1 <-ggarrange(p1_nh, p1_sh,ncol =1, nrow = 2,heights = c(1,1),
                 labels = c("A","B"),  hjust=-1, vjust=1.5,align = "hv",
                 legend = "bottom", common.legend = T,
                 font.label = list(size = 24, face = "bold"))
fig1 

ggsave(filename = file.path(out_path1, "/Fig1A.pdf"),
       plot     = fig1,width    = 18.2,height   = 8,device   = cairo_pdf, family   = "Arial")

```
